facts.F1: 72 road pieces were checked: 35 judged flooded, 21 uncertain, the rest judged dry.
facts.F2: Buildings: 17 isolated (cut off from every exit road), 0 uncertain, 1 still reachable, 4 with no mapped road nearby.
facts.F3: Priority 1: enter at map reference (29.68147, -89.97420); a crew entering here is closest to 6 isolated buildings.
facts.F4: Priority 2: enter at map reference (29.68351, -89.97081); a crew entering here is closest to 3 isolated buildings.
facts.F5: Priority 3: enter at map reference (29.67997, -89.97421); a crew entering here is closest to 2 isolated buildings.
facts.F6: Priority 4: enter at map reference (29.67979, -89.97421); a crew entering here is closest to 2 isolated buildings.
facts.F7: In testing on 20 SpaceNet 8 tiles, 1 of 666 truly cut-off buildings was marked reachable. How often an 'isolated' call was right depended on the area: roughly 4 to 5 in 10 where most buildings could still get out, and 98 in 100 where nearly all were cut off. Treat 'isolated' as a reason to check, not a confirmed cut-off.
facts.F8: Flood judgements come from a vision model reading satellite photos and are not field-verified; uncertain roads need a drone or ground check.
